notes.title: Seinarukana is Nearing Release!
notes.content:
We're happy to announce Seinarukana will be releasing soon! But first, we'd like to thank everyone for your patience over the past few months as we polished up Seinarukana for release. 

Seinarukana is a engaging strategy JRPG that continues the story of Aselia The Eternal with a new cast of memorable characters, plus a few familiar faces. Battle enemies across an infinite multiverse as you struggle to return home. Can you and your friends survive, or will you be consumed by the ancient power that lurks inside of you?
  
Our team wanted to ensure the best translation for this release, so we spent extra time polishing character dialog and fixing game engine bugs along the way. We hope you enjoy this labor of love, from Xuse and all of us at JAST USA.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24383868/b210911dbf69f8356c4e6168e830e0932610847d.jpg[/img]
